Compare the real cost, not just the headline price

When comparing two properties, look at total price, down payment, instalment schedule, unit area, finishing condition and delivery timing together. A lower entry payment does not necessarily mean a lower overall purchase cost. Ask whether maintenance fees, club fees and other charges are included in the quoted figures.

Our New Cairo guide, payment plan comparison and off-plan checklist explain how to compare similar units fairly. You can also review our data and calculation methodology.

Price per square metre by area

Median price per square metre across residential units listed by Tycoons in October 2026, as a starting point for comparison (installment prices, not final offers):

  • Mostakbal City: about EGP 90,000 per m², with plans from 1.5% down over up to 12 years.
  • New Administrative Capital: about EGP 78,000 per m².
  • 6th of October: about EGP 110,000 per m².
  • New Cairo and the Fifth Settlement: about EGP 116,000 per m²; a typical 127 m² apartment is about EGP 12 million.
  • Sheikh Zayed and New Zayed: about EGP 125,000 per m²; a typical 146 m² apartment is about EGP 17 million.
  • North Coast: about EGP 178,000 per m²; a typical 136 m² chalet is about EGP 22 million.

Project guides in English

Our most detailed project pages include location, unit types, prices by type, price per square metre against the area and nearby projects, payment plans, delivery and a buyer checklist:

Palm Hills New Cairo · Mountain View 1.1 · One Hyde Park · Villette · Solay · Mountain View Aliva · Bloomfields · Badya · Jirian · P/X · Hacienda Waters · Ogami · Fouka Bay

Payment plans you will see

Most new projects ask for 5% down over 8–10 years. Some offer 2.5–3% over 12 years, such as Mountain View projects and Palm Hills' Hacienda Blue, while ready or near-ready homes usually need 10–20% down over shorter terms. A "5% + 5%" plan means a real down payment of 10% within a few months. Shorter plans often carry large discounts: in 97 Hills, choosing 6 years instead of 10 cuts the price by about 29%.

Who we are

Tycoons Investments is a property brokerage based in the Fifth Settlement, New Cairo (Hyde Park Business District, Office 14), working directly with developers across New Cairo, Mostakbal City, the New Capital, Sheikh Zayed, the North Coast and Ain Sokhna. Our guides are written and reviewed by Ahmed Mahmoud, founder of Tycoons Investments, with 11 years in the Egyptian property market. We do not add a commission to the developer's price for buyers.

How we handle prices and availability

Published prices and availability can change. Before making a decision, request confirmation of the specific unit, its current price, payment schedule, delivery conditions and contractual details. Any rental yield or resale scenario is an estimate, never a guaranteed return.
